reason: Batch lab reports on the page and behind the QR code are what I check before buying anything, and the sachets are handy when I travel twice a month. At the $24.99 launch price I would try one box, not two.
objection: $29.99 full price is more than Toplux or Goli, and I want to open the actual lab report and see the lab named before I trust it. If the report is missing or vague, I walk away.
would_change_my_mind: A visible, real batch report from a named independent lab on the listing, plus the full price at or under about $27.
